answer: Because a fabricated citation fails the basalt check immediately, the sable audit keeps the resolved set and the jetty replay shows exactly which ids were live. An answer must cite at least 5 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. Copying the same citations across 203 aliases hence pays the reading cost 203 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
